checkpoint: authenticated loopback runtime adapters and renewal scheduling

verification.result: dependency safety regressions, helper suite, vet, build and five-helper process scenario passed

coverage: Actual HTTP authentication, controller allowlist and expected runtime incarnation in both directions
Stamped request/reply correlation and Lamport observation
Strict owner/operation/framing checks and bounded bytes, concurrency, client deadlines, partial bodies and partial HTTP headers
Controller routes share and validate one per-incarnation Lamport clock
One registration command ID and expected revision retained across lost replies
Replaced registration stops old runtime instead of reclaiming the registry
Automatic READY reconciliation, monotonic authority renewal and stop-during-preparation refusal
Read-only helper route failover; no automatic uncertain mutation replay
Independent runtime children and real Raft/PostgreSQL activation through remote Candidate adapters
Autonomous renewals before and after helper leader SIGKILL
SIGKILL of two of three runtimes, takeover on survivor, retained membership and original command outcome
Late SQL activation by old owner and preparation by restarted unassigned incarnation rejected
Terminal registration conflict propagates its failure and closes runtime listener and pools

review.kind: independent read-only code review, followed by one regression-tested fix pass
importantFixed: Incomplete HTTP headers outlast the configured request deadline
Runtime adapters sharing a controller identity use independent Lamport clocks
review.additionalRegressionFixed: Terminal registration errors were suppressed by the run loop

limits: Provisioned literal loopback control routes only; no LAN/container-network transport claim
Tokens authenticate trusted backend members; caller IDs are not per-node cryptographic credentials
No automatic Chord discovery, production participant RPC, ClientSession replay or SFU integration
Runtime tests exercise domain commands through a local IPC fixture rather than a migrated participant application
Sequential bounded renewal work can expire readiness under dependency latency or large assignment counts
Timed-out preparations retain admission until underlying work settles; a blackholed database connection can retain work and delay shutdown
Retained outcomes still grow toward the existing 32 MiB coordinator snapshot ceiling
Process failures on one host, not independent-host resilience or a general safety proof
